Name: Danganronpa Male's Hairstyles

Description:
A simple mod that just seeks to add male hair for the boys from Danganronpa because there's already one with the girls' hair. Currently, there are only like 4 hairs (help--)

This will be updated from time to time because I'm lazy 🦭💧

For more details or if you want to see progress of the mod, you can check my [url=https://bsky.app/profile/r-fr1tz.bsky.social]BluesSky [/url](where I also usually draw or repost fanarts).
